question: Which programming languages do junior data analyst jobs ask for?
sources:
[1] Data Analyst (Junior) at Lexical Intelligence (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Data Analyst (Junior)  Lexical Intelligence provides software and services related to processing large-scale biomedical information sources. Our NLP and analytics software is used by policy and decision makers to evaluate and prioritize current and emerging areas of research.
We are looking for a junior-level analyst with excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data in Excel.
The candidate must enjoy collaborative work, actively participate in the development of team presentations, and engage in review of other analyst findings.
ResponsibilitiesThe Junior Analyst will be responsible for examining data from different sources with the goal of providing insights into NHLBI, its mission, business processes, and information systems.

[2] Data Engineer at Chmura Economics & Analytics (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-15)
RequirementsExperience in at least one of these relevant programming languages: C#, Python, Java, etc.Experience with Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or other NoSQL experienceExperience with containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, etc)Experience with schema design and writing queries for SQL Server, Postgres or similarAzure experienceKanban/Agile experienceFamiliarity with machine learning and NLP is nice to have but not requiredAt least 2 years. [3] Data Analyst - Remote at ICF (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-20)
We are looking for a seasoned Data Analyst who will be a key driver to make this happen. We are seeking an analyst who is eager to use their advanced analytical and data transformation techniques, their visualization knowledge, and skills in Looker (or other related BI tools), SQL, and programming to rapidly turn data into insights and to develop practical tools and analyses that can help solve complex business problems, transforming volumes of data into actionable information.

[4] Junior Data Analyst at Gypsum Management and Supply (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
GMS and its family of companies operate a network of nearly 300 building product distribution yards, and more than 100 tool sales and service centers, for customers across the U.S. and Canada. The Field Support Center in Tucker, Georgia serves each GMS location, providing the support needed to enable local teams to deliver outstanding service to contractors and builders in their local communities.
Position Summary
The primary function of the FP&A Junior Data Analyst is to create, maintain, analyze, and improve a wide variety of PowerBI reports and dashboards which help to analyze key areas of the business to ensure all leaders and managers are able to make informed decisions. This position will work with the PowerBI team to help create meaningful analysis tools using all facets of Microsoft BI and other data tools. This position will be expected to quickly and efficiently respond to ad-hoc user requests with scalable solutions.

[5] Data Analyst - Programmer (Department of Translational Medicine and Human Genetics) at University of Pennsylvania (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Duties
Provide informatics support on research projects, including:Design and implementation of large-scale data studiesAnalysis of complex datasets from various sources (Electronic Health Records, surveys)Develop custom tools using programming languages (Python, R, Java) for:Data cleaning and conversionAdvanced data analysisAssist in developing complex EHR-based phenotype definitions using clinical ontologies (ICD-9/10, CPT, LOINC, OMOP, RxNorm)Prepare datasets for analysis by other investigatorsImplement data quality assurance procedures to ensure data validity and reliability.
